comment: Editorial copy for the Design Release 2.1 progress page: the parts no backlog records. Lifted from the 12 October hand-built data.js so a rebuild keeps them. Everything else on the page is derived by make-data.mjs.

page.heldReason: The type question and templates theme was paused on 12 October so Sam could review it. These five rows were left unbuilt, and the theme has since become a stale branch: when it is played again, they are built with the rest of it from a fresh branch off main.

e2e.label: Proved once, on 12 October: 433 passed, 7 skipped, 0 failed, on a dev-mode stack of the combined branch. Re-proved after templates merged in: 500 passed, with two failures and one flaky test fixed in 9740498.

combined.note: A review snapshot, not the current build. It holds the five themes whose branches went stale on 20 October, so what it shows was built before those rows were reset. Never merge it: each theme merges to main through its own pull requests.

page.mainBacklogNote: Rows not yet split off to a theme branch.

prose.headline:
Traders move through a live-animals notification in Design Release 2.1's order.

- A page opened from the overview goes back to the overview when saved.
- They can leave a page unfinished.
- An amendment gives them a choice of where to go after each save.
prose.whatChanges:
The opening run now:
- asks for the main reason for import before commodity details
- no longer stops at the CPH number page
- always ends on the review page

A page opened from an overview task goes back to the overview when saved. It does not run on through its section.

'Save and return to overview' saves an unfinished page. A badly formatted answer is still refused.

While amending, pages end with 'Save and return', 'Save and continue' and 'Save and return to overview'.

Continue on the amend review is held until everything is complete and valid.
prose.today:
Today the opening run:
- asks for commodity details before the reason for import
- sends traders to the CPH number page after 'Roles and addresses'

From the overview, a save carries on through the rest of the section before it returns.

'Save and return to overview' is refused on the same errors as 'Save and continue'.

When amending, saving a page opened from a Change link always goes back to the notification view.

- commodities and reason
- arrival and transit
- documents
- transporters

prose.headline:
Country and port lists in the GB notification services show what master reference data really serves.

- Destination countries include their territories.
- Ports are listed airports first, then seaports, then rail.
prose.whatChanges:
First, the stub is tidied up so it serves the same countries and ports as real master reference data (MDM).

It also filters countries by block the way MDM does.

Then every captured copy of those lists is recaptured from it. These copies are in the animals frontend, the INS frontend and the tests repo.

After that, the destination country selects on the import reason page offer territories as well as countries.

The port of entry and port of exit lists are ordered by port type. They use the type MDM already holds for each port.

No list entry is added, removed or respelt in code.
prose.today:
The stub serves:
- 78 hand-kept ports, with no port type
- 31 hand-kept countries

It ignores the block filter.

The destination country selects offer those 31 countries, with no territories.

Ports are sorted by name alone, and case matters. So airports and seaports are mixed, and names in capitals come first.

The INS frontend's stub mode offers four hand-typed countries.

byRepo.what:
- Serves MDM's real country and port records whole and in MDM's order.
- Filters countries by block.
- Its own tests check the new data.

- Returns each port's type (airport, seaport or rail) from MDM.
- Orders the port list by type, then A to Z by name, ignoring letter case.

- Recaptures its country and port data from the tidied stub.
- Adds territories to the destination country selects.
- Gives port of exit options the same label and order as port of entry.
Stub mode's Country select in the address book offers the recaptured country list instead of four hand-typed countries.

- Takes country names from the recaptured data.
- Drops an unused hand-kept list.
- Expects the real counts and orders.

risks:
inc-173 gates six list rows across four themes: inc-006, inc-007, inc-008, inc-082, inc-174, inc-175.

It has 13 criteria.

The report suggests it could be split into a countries row and a ports row.

MDM's duplicate and misspelt ports stay in the list on purpose.

No test may assert a particular port name, entry or count that pins them.

List content differs by environment:
- the stub locally and in CDP dev
- real MDM in CDP test

Tests must assert order and shape, not named entries.

The destination country change (inc-006) sits in the import reason page's code. The commodities-and-reason theme owns that code.

Builders of both themes should coordinate.

- every changed string gets Welsh

- malformed answers are refused
- 'Save and continue' needs the page's required answers
- 'Save and return to overview' saves without required checks, as it does for a notification
